messages.body: Which line should I add to README.md? A: 'Verified by an orchestration run.' B: 'Orchestration check passed.'

messages.subject: Verification PR opened
messages.body: Coordinator answered A, so I appended 'Verified by an orchestration run.' as the last line of README.md, committed it as 'docs: add verification line', and pushed acme/fo-orch-r1 to origin. I opened PR https://github.com/acme/sandbox/pull/17 against main with the requested title and body. Nothing is left except closing the disposable PR, which the task did not ask for.
messages.followUp: To give this worker more work: orca orchestration send --to dispatch:ctx_000000000001 --subject "..." --body "..."
